name: AXM Academy · Learning Lab
summary: A local-first Academy that translates curated Workshop organ data and module contracts into categorized, source-linked human lessons, offers an optional non-enrolling foundation trail, and uses the Learning Lab for attributed practice, visible evidence review, targeted repair, assessment, simulation, notebooks and a door into the separate AI Learning Forge.
notes: The Academy is the teaching front door of Learning Lab parent #10, not a second school. A versioned JSON catalog admits only local, categorized, adapter-backed sources with explicit non-claim boundaries. A separate versioned learning-path catalog can suggest a reasoned first route only through admitted sources; progress joins attributed sessions to exact current fingerprints. Completion on an older source or compiler edition remains visible as preserved history and never silently counts as current. The next action only opens a lesson for inspection; it cannot enroll, certify mastery or make curriculum canon. Source paths, producing organs, extracted facts, boundaries, admission receipts and deterministic non-cryptographic lesson fingerprints remain attached to every compiled lesson. Fingerprint v2 also binds the named compiler recipe and exact generated steps, so a teaching-code change cannot silently reuse an edition receipt. Changed source semantics or compiler output create a separate reviewed edition; prior courses and sessions are not rewritten. A strict single-lesson inheritance packet can carry one fingerprinted edition forward without learner profiles, sessions, attempts, notebooks, classroom messages or private evidence. Import recompiles it and opens a non-mutating human review; only a second explicit action admits the course. A learner can explicitly add and begin an Academy lesson, preserve evidence at each step, reload, and resume through the portable Learning Lab project. Full-project import re-derives progress and authority from visible evidence, pauses unfinished sessions, resets consent and live school readiness, and treats imported code results as unverified until rerun locally. Mirror's school stays a separate executable child with separate identity, consent, learned state and promotion gates. Grades never grant authority and no learner is enrolled automatically.
